data.name: OwnProviderIntro
data.value: With Enhanced AI, your department can connect its own subscription with an AI provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI or Mistral, or with a model server you run. The chatbot then sends this department's messages to that provider under your agreement with them. Leave these fields empty to use Resgrid's own AI, which never sends your data to cloud AI providers.
